problem.title: Playback problem?
problem.question: What's wrong on {{source}}?
problem.note: Sound, subtitles and quality come from each source's own player: another source may have them.

status.title: Status
status.subtitle: Is Taurus up, and which sources play right now. Taurus hosts no videos: each source is another site's player.
status.siteDownText: Our server didn't answer from here. If other sites open, Taurus may be down for everyone: try again in a few minutes.
status.noSourceWorking: No source is working right now. Try again later.
status.testText: A source doesn't open for you? Test every source from your connection: down for everyone, or just for you?
status.allReachable: Every working source can be reached from your connection.
status.blockedHere: Sources up for everyone but not reachable from your connection: {{blocked}}. Your network, a DNS filter or an ad blocker may stop them: try another network, or turn the blocker off for Taurus.
status.note: Our server reaches every source every 15 minutes, and every night a test plays a few films and episodes on each one.
status.scout: Nightly playback test ({{date}}): {{played}} of {{tested}} test titles played
status.viewers: Viewers, last 24 h: {{share}} of plays worked
